evolution.initial_seed: the scenario's frozen optimized Adaptive PIL

configuration.initialization: exact outer five-parameter Adaptive PIL formula and the original frozen conditional projection bank
configuration.seed_generation_zero: original EOH may further optimize generation zero on train; compare final with the original frozen Adaptive PIL as well
configuration.search_freedom: unbounded OPT_PARAM count; mutate the whole outer decision rule, add coefficients, or ignore helpers
configuration.selection: training only; retain the best training policy; no guarantee of test improvement
configuration.holdout_gate: all 18 policies frozen before new validation or test scoring
configuration.interpretation: exploratory initialization experiment on the existing benchmark; not a fresh unseen holdout
